'''Till'in''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]], Till'in was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], eventually attaining the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]].

[[File:Tillin-TheLostSuns2.jpg|left|thumb|Till'in during the Great Galactic War]]
At some point, Till'in was stationed at the Order's [[Jedi enclave (Haashimut)|enclave]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Haashimut]]. It was Till'in who was forced to explain to [[Theron Shan]] that he was not Force-sensitive therefore could not remain in the Jedi Order.<ref name="Lost Suns 2" />

Following the [[Great Galactic War]] and the resurgence of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Master Till'in returned to the ancestral Jedi homeworld [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] with the rest of the Order and helped rebuild during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], residing at the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Temple]] there. While still accepting assignments, Master Till'in had business on [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]] when he came across a young [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] adolescent named [[Fia (Jedi)|Fia]]. Frightened by his appearance, Fia shot at the Jedi Master; an action she would later regret as the Jedi approached her and asked her to join the Order. Taking her to Tython, Fia would constantly apologize for attempting to kill him, much to his annoyance.<ref name="TOR" />

A respected [[Jedi archaeologist|archaeologist]], Master Till'in made a camp outside the ruins of the ancient fortress city [[Kaleth]] and used his considerable knowledge of ancient technology to analyze the bizarre programming of the ancient [[Tythonian War Droid]]s protecting the ruins.<ref name="TOR" /> He hired a traveling [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] to collect memory cores from the droids. These cores revealed that the droids were activated thousands of years ago by the dark side forces of the [[Force Wars]] as a last effort just before their own demise to eliminate the light side forces.
